services.name: Snorkel Tours
services.desc: This is the ultimate snorkeling near me! Enjoy a one hour snorkel location captain's choice for best visibility and conditions. A shallow reef in 8-20 feet of water, loaded with fish and pristine corals. It is just a short ride out to the snorkel site! Explore under ledges, it is so much fun to see just how many species of fish you can find! This is a 2 hour tour that leaves the dock daily! Don’t forget to check in 30 minutes prior! All deposits are non-refundable with no exceptions. See you underwater! © 2020 Islander Girl Snorkel & Tours. Website Designed & Powered by Aquatic Digital

services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: As the Sun slips beneath the distant horizon, let the cares of the day slip away on board the Crown Conch! On board every night sip on your complimentary glass of champagne and enjoy appetizers. The sun disappears but the food and drinks do not. Sit back and enjoy the cotton candy colored sky with the music playing and the disco ball spinning you are bound to have a wonderful time. Trip duration is 2 hours. All deposits are non-refundable with no exceptions. © 2020 Islander Girl Snorkel & Tours. Website Designed & Powered by Aquatic Digital
